title: TrainingRunRecord
description: Versioned full-fidelity record of one ML training run, written to run.json. Schema version 1.1. Captures run-level metadata, the resolved training configuration, per-epoch records (each with its reliability bins), the best epoch by the configured selection metric, and an optional held-out test block. All non-finite floats are emitted as null so the JSON stays strictly valid. Renamed from 'run_record' at egm-contracts v0.3.0 to leave naming room for future per-activity run records (e.g. inference_run_record, hybrid_eval_run_record); the convention matches noise_bank_run_record (extraction-side). 1.1 (from 1.0) added the optional stable-artifact pointer fields `run_id` / `trained_on_bank_id` / `produced_model_id` (egm-contracts v0.5.0, cross-artifact linkage).

schema_version.description: Versioned schema identifier in <package>.<format>/<major>.<minor> form. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

run_id.description: Stable artifact ID of THIS training run, e.g. 'run_v1_5_courtemanche_2026-06-25'. The run's own cross-artifact identifier — distinct from the free-form 'run_id' well-known key inside the `run` object below (producers SHOULD make the two equal when both are set). Optional for legacy records written before egm-contracts v0.5.0; egm-classifier stamps it at train time. Added 1.1.

trained_on_bank_id.description: Stable artifact ID of the training bank this run consumed, e.g. 'tbank_synthetic_courtemanche_v1_5_2026-06-25'. Relationship pointer (run -> bank; future graph edge TRAINED_ON). Optional; stamped at train time. Added 1.1.

produced_model_id.description: Stable artifact ID of the model this run produced, e.g. 'model_egm_classifier_v1_5_2026-06-25'. Relationship pointer (run -> model; future graph edge PRODUCED). Optional; stamped at export time. Added 1.1.

run.description: Run-level metadata. Well-known keys (producer SHOULD write all of these): 'git_sha' (string, repo state at training time), 'host' (string, hostname where training ran), 'model_version' (string, model architecture version tag), 'training_started_utc' / 'training_ended_utc' (ISO date-times). Additional keys allowed for forward compatibility. The run's stable cross-artifact id lives in the top-level `run_id` field, not here.

config.description: The fully-resolved training configuration as a flat-ish nested dict. Well-known top-level keys: 'model' (architecture + hyperparameters), 'data' (augmentation, split ratios), 'training' (optimizer, scheduler, epochs, batch size, loss), 'eval' (selection metric, decision threshold). The training bank's stable id lives in the top-level `trained_on_bank_id` field, not in config.data. The contents reflect whatever the producer's config system serializes; consumers should treat unknown keys as additional context rather than fail on them.

epochs.description: Time series of per-epoch records, ordered by epoch number.

items.description: One epoch's record (loss / metrics / reliability for that epoch).

best.description: Summary of the best epoch by the configured selection metric.

test.description: Held-out test metrics, present iff a test split was evaluated.

BestEpoch.title: BestEpoch
BestEpoch.description: Summary of the best epoch by the configured selection metric.

epoch.description: 1-based epoch number that scored best by the selection metric.

metric.description: Metric used for selection (e.g. 'auroc', or 'neg_val_loss' as a fallback when the configured metric was non-finite on every epoch).

value.description: The metric value at the selected epoch. Null when the metric was undefined across every epoch.

HeldOutTest.title: HeldOutTest
HeldOutTest.description: Held-out test metrics block (loss + scalar metrics + reliability bins). Present in a TrainingRunRecord iff a test split was evaluated at the end of training.

loss.description: Mean test-set loss across batches. Null when the test split was empty.

metrics.description: Scalar test metrics (auroc, accuracy, precision, recall, f1, ece, ...). Keys are metric names; values are scalars or null when the metric was undefined.

additionalProperties.description: Scalar value for the named metric, or null when undefined.

reliability.description: Reliability bins computed on the test split (calibration-diagram input).

items.description: One bin of the reliability diagram for the test split.

EpochRecord.description: Full per-epoch record: scalar losses, scalar metrics, calibration bins.

epoch.description: 1-based epoch number, strictly increasing across the run.

lr.description: Learning rate at the epoch's last optimizer step.

train_loss.description: Mean training-set loss across all batches in the epoch.

val_loss.description: Mean validation-set loss across all batches in the epoch.

epoch_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds spent on this epoch (training + validation).

val_metrics.description: Scalar validation metrics for the epoch (auroc / accuracy / precision / recall / f1 / ece). Confusion-matrix counts may appear under a nested 'confusion' object with keys tp/fp/tn/fn. Additional producer-defined keys allowed.

val_reliability.description: Validation-split reliability bins for the calibration diagram.

items.description: One bin of the validation reliability diagram for this epoch.

lo.description: Lower edge of the predicted-probability bin (in [0, 1]).

hi.description: Upper edge of the predicted-probability bin (in [0, 1]).

count.description: Number of samples whose predicted probability for the positive class fell in (lo, hi].

confidence.description: Mean predicted probability across the bin (null if count == 0).

accuracy.description: Empirical accuracy across the bin (null if count == 0). For a well-calibrated model, accuracy ≈ confidence in every bin.
